scene.note: The shop's website stops being copied around and starts keeping a history.

steps.note: The shop's folder holds four files and no record of how they got there.
You turn that very folder into a repository, from inside it.
An empty history is ready. Nothing is saved in it yet.
Every commit will carry a name and an email.
You store yours in the settings of this repository, and of no other.
From now on the history can say who saved each change.
The site as Femi left it: four files, all still untracked.
Every file goes into the staging area, unchanged.
One commit saves them together as the first snapshot.
Wilma has new Saturday opening hours.
One line of the visit page changes in the editor.
That one change is staged and saved as the next snapshot, after the first.
